arxiv.title: Representational Difference Distillation
arxiv.abstract: Knowledge distillation transfers representational knowledge from a large teacher network to a compact student. Existing relational and contrastive distillation methods treat all samples uniformly, spending equal gradient on well-matched and poorly-matched regions of the representation space alike. We propose Representational Difference Distillation (RDD), which diagnoses where teacher and student representations structurally disagree and concentrates the distillation signal on those regions. RDD uses two asymmetric affinity matrices that capture opposing directions of misalignment: one identifies samples the student incorrectly considers similar, the other identifies teacher relationships the student has yet to learn. These affinities determine which sample pairs the distillation loss aligns and how strongly it corrects each misaligned sample. On CIFAR-100 with resnet32x4 to resnet8x4, RDD reaches 75.58% test accuracy in our runs, on par with CRD (75.45%) and above KD and RKD. We additionally explore curriculum-based and sampling-based variants, finding that weighting the loss is more effective than filtering the data.
arxiv.titleZh: 表征差异蒸馏
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有关系型与对比型蒸馏对所有样本一视同仁，在表征空间中匹配良好与匹配很差的区域上花费相同梯度。RDD 用两个非对称亲和矩阵刻画师生表征错配的两个相反方向:学生误判为相似的样本，以及教师已有而学生尚未学到的关系;二者共同决定蒸馏损失对齐哪些样本对、以及每个错配样本的校正强度。在 CIFAR-100 上以 resnet32x4 蒸馏到 resnet8x4，测试精度 75.58%，与 CRD(75.45%)持平，高于 KD 与 RKD。作者还尝试了课程式与采样式变体，发现对损失加权比过滤数据更有效。
arxiv.reason: 视觉分类的经典知识蒸馏改进，与 LLM 后训练蒸馏基本无关且增益有限

arxiv.title: Dissipative Lagrangian Neural Networks for the Interpretable Modelling of Passive Mechanical Systems
arxiv.abstract: In this paper, we propose the Dissipative Lagrangian Neural Network (dLNN), a continuous-time system identification technique that separately learns the conservative and dissipative dynamics of a mechanical system directly from data. A key contribution is a novel parametrisation of dissipative forces that (i) is structurally constrained to be dissipative, enforcing passivity of the learned model, (ii) cannot absorb conservative mechanics, and (iii) retains sufficient expressivity to represent a broad family of state-dependent damping and regularised friction forces. The model is validated on prediction tasks on two real-world mechanical systems: trajectory prediction of a chaotic double pendulum and inverse-dynamics modelling of a six-degree-of-freedom industrial robot. Across these tasks, the dLNN demonstrates improved predictive performance over existing Lagrangian architectures while remaining competitive with a black-box neural model. The imposed physical structure also improves generalisation to unseen states, with the benefits becoming particularly pronounced when training data is limited. Finally, we introduce a symbolic distillation procedure that extracts closed-form expressions from the learned physical components. Applied to the industrial robot, this produces interpretable symbolic models that retain high predictive accuracy while reducing the computational overhead associated with evaluating neural Lagrangian models.
arxiv.titleZh: 耗散拉格朗日神经网络:面向被动机械系统的可解释建模
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对机械系统辨识中保守与耗散动力学难以分离的问题，提出连续时间辨识方法 dLNN，用结构约束的参数化分别学习保守项与耗散力，保证学到的模型严格被动、无法吞掉保守力学，同时保留对状态相关阻尼与正则化摩擦的表达力。在混沌双摆轨迹预测与六自由度工业机器人逆动力学两项真实任务上，预测精度优于既有拉格朗日架构，并与黑盒神经网络相当，且数据受限时泛化优势更明显。作者还用符号蒸馏从学到的物理分量中抽取闭式表达式，在机器人任务上兼顾精度与推理开销。
arxiv.reason: 物理/机器人系统辨识，与 LLM 各方向无实质交集

arxiv.title: Large language model-generated patterns for epidemiological modeling: a multi-benchmark evaluation framework
arxiv.abstract: Representing individual-level behavioral heterogeneity is challenging in epidemiological modeling, particularly when empirical behavioral data are sparse. We assess the potential of large language model (LLM)-generated behavioral outputs in addressing this challenge, using hepatitis C virus-related behaviors among people who inject drugs as a case study. Correspondence with epidemiological patterns was evaluated using external benchmarks: literature-informed association directions, correlations from an agent-based model (ABM), and survey associations. Across three LLMs, unconditional directional recovery across 28 retained literature-informed associations was 46-68%, compared with 82-93% agreement when LLMs were directly asked to classify the same associations. Mean absolute differences from ABM and survey correlation patterns were 0.11-0.13 and 0.15-0.18, respectively. Together, these findings show partial alignment between LLM-generated behavioral relationships and epidemiological evidence, despite higher knowledge-probe agreement. More systematic evaluation is needed before incorporating LLM-generated behavioral outputs into epidemiological models that simulate transmission dynamics.
arxiv.titleZh: 大语言模型生成的模式用于流行病学建模:一个多基准评估框架
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对流行病学建模中个体行为异质性难以刻画、经验行为数据稀疏的问题，以注射吸毒人群的丙型肝炎相关行为为案例，评估 LLM 生成的行为输出能否替代或补充经验数据。研究构建多基准评估框架，用文献推导的关联方向、agent-based model(ABM)相关性与问卷关联三类外部证据做对照。结果显示，三个 LLM 在 28 条保留的文献关联上无条件方向复现率为 46–68%，而直接让模型判别同一批关联时一致率可达 82–93%;与 ABM、问卷相关模式的平均绝对偏差分别为 0.11–0.13 与 0.15–0.18。结论是 LLM 生成的行为关系与流行病学证据仅部分对齐，在纳入传播动力学模拟前仍需更系统的评估。
arxiv.reason: LLM 用于流行病学垂直应用，仅擦边关注方向

arxiv.title: Handoff Curves: Initial Selection, Later Handoff, and Supervision Targets in Multi-turn LLM Routing
arxiv.abstract: We study how initial model selection, later handoff, and training targets affect success and cost in LLM tasks that span multiple turns. We compare several router architectures using handoff curves, which record task success and cost as the handoff step changes. Our dataset contains 34,204 complete executions of three Qwen models across BFCL, MultiWOZ, and $τ$-retail, providing offline supervision for routing decisions. In our primary comparison, with Qwen3.5 35B-A3B as the starting model, allowing a later handoff does not establish an improvement in utility over initial selection on BFCL or MultiWOZ, and increases cost on BFCL across a range of cost weights. Changing the supervision targets improves router performance on both our dataset and TwinRouterBench. On our dataset, replacing noisy training success curves with monotone fits raises success by 0.2 to 4.1 percentage points at the same cost across the reported operating points. On TwinRouterBench, we construct targets that describe the model capability needed for the remaining work and difficult steps ahead. Compared with training on the benchmark's per-step labels, these targets raise trajectory pass scores by 7.8 percentage points and cost savings by 6.3 percentage points on the full static bank. A live deployment of the router trained with these targets resolves 79 of 100 instances at a router cost of 0.59 US dollars per instance.
arxiv.titleZh: 交接曲线：多轮 LLM 路由中的初始选择、后续交接与监督目标
arxiv.summaryZh: 多轮 LLM 任务中，先选模型还是中途交接更划算、监督信号该怎么造，此前缺乏系统对照。作者用「交接曲线」记录不同交接步下的任务成功率与成本，在 BFCL、MultiWOZ、τ-retail 上收集三个 Qwen 模型的 34,204 条完整执行轨迹做离线监督。结果显示:以 Qwen3.5 35B-A3B 为起始模型时，允许后续交接在 BFCL、MultiWOZ 上并未比初始选择带来效用提升，反而在 BFCL 上跨多个成本权重推高开销。将噪声较大的训练成功曲线替换为单调拟合，在相同成本下成功率提升 0.2–4.1 个百分点;在 TwinRouterBench 上改用描述「剩余工作与后续难步所需能力」的监督目标，轨迹通过分数提升 7.8 个百分点、成本节省提升 6.3 个百分点，线上部署以每实例 0.59 美元的路由成本解决 100 个实例中的 79 个。
arxiv.reason: 多轮路由与监督目标设计，属系统效率擦边，方法扎实但增量

arxiv.title: Revocation Is Not Complete at Receipt: An Executable Outcome Contract for Distributed Agent-Tool Gateways
arxiv.abstract: Distributed agent workflows cache delegated authority at tool gateways. Revocation may be reported at issuer commit, transport acknowledgment, or receiver persistence, although none of these observations establishes that all gateways enforced the change or that guarded effects stopped. We define C0-C5, a bounded outcome contract spanning issuer commit through effect prevention, and implement it as a persistent monitor over a frozen gateway set, call set, and observation window. A 14-case fault matrix checks conservative classification, sticky violations, restart persistence, and evidence immutability. In a derived audit of its eight semantic cases, treating C3 or C4 as completion produces seven or five false positives, respectively; the bounded C0-C5 verdict produces none. Descriptive scaling covers 1,024 gateways and 10,000 effect vectors. The primary experiment uses the maintained Keycloak 26.7 identity server and measures the contract across two durable receivers, eight physical agent-tool gateways, Filesystem and PostgreSQL effects, and 16 AWS hosts in three availability zones. Normal delivery and recovery commit no effects. Under receiver-selective non-delivery, transport acknowledgment and receiver persistence still succeed, but 112 of 225 calls (49.78%) are admitted, and all 112 effects commit in every treatment block. A separately provisioned execution repeats the result. OPA/Toxiproxy and a live three-role LLM workflow with networked MCP tools reproduce the persisted-but-not-enforced boundary on narrower surfaces. Finally, an unmodified external MCPMark agent executes 60 closed-loop task arms. Normal C4 denies all 31 exposed post-barrier calls and commits no effect; selective C3 allows 344 calls and commits 145 effects across Filesystem and PostgreSQL. Transport success is therefore evidence of progress, not a revocation-completion verdict.
arxiv.titleZh: 撤销在收到确认时并未完成:面向分布式 Agent-工具网关的可执行结果契约
arxiv.summaryZh: 分布式 Agent 工作流会在工具网关缓存被委托的权限，但签发提交、传输确认与接收方持久化都不足以证明撤销已被所有网关强制执行。为此提出 C0–C5 有界结果契约，覆盖从签发提交到效果阻止的全链路，并以持久化监控器在固定网关集、调用集与观测窗口上实现;14 例故障矩阵与 8 个语义用例审计显示，把 C3 或 C4 当作完成会产生 7 或 5 个假阳性，C0–C5 判定为零。主实验基于 Keycloak 26.7、八个物理 Agent-Tool 网关、Filesystem 与 PostgreSQL 效果，接收方选择性不投递时传输确认与持久化仍然成功，但 225 次调用中 112 次(49.78%)被放行且效果全部提交;外部 MCPMark Agent 的 60 个闭环任务臂复现同一边界，说明传输层成功只是进度证据，而非撤销完成判定。
arxiv.reason: Agent 工具网关撤销语义与 MCP 复现，属 Agent 基建安全，非 LLM 方法核心

arxiv.title: Probabilistic Forecasting of Wildfire Size Using Conditional Flow Matching
arxiv.abstract: In this work we present a probabilistic model for predicting the temporal evolution of wildfire size using conditional generative algorithms, namely flow matching. Rather than predicting spatially resolved fire progression, the proposed model forecasts a time series of fire acreage, substantially reducing computational cost and enabling efficient integration with downstream applications such as early warning systems and risk assessment tools. Given estimates of the fire size at the current and previous forecasting steps, alongside spatially averaged weather conditions, terrain characteristics, and fuel composition, the model predicts the change in fire area over a 3-hour interval. Training data are drawn from 140 coupled atmosphere-wildfire simulations generated using WRF-SFIRE, paired with weather data from the North American Mesoscale (NAM) model. Sensitivity analysis demonstrates that the model captures physically-consistent responses to variations in wind speed, temperature, and relative humidity. Model performance is evaluated against reference solutions from WRF-SFIRE. For single-step predictions, the model achieves a symmetric mean absolute percentage error (sMAPE) of 0.39 relative to the reference WRF-SFIRE solutions. Recursive multi-step predictions over 24 hours are performed for 12 held-out test cases, where the flow matching model achieves a final fire area sMAPE of 0.39 while further providing meaningful quantification of forecast uncertainty.
arxiv.comment: 18 pages, 7 figures, 1 table. Code and data: https://github.com/isaaclee2/Wildfire_Size_Flow_Matching
arxiv.titleZh: 基于条件流匹配的野火规模概率预测
arxiv.summaryZh: 把野火蔓延预测简化为区域过火面积的时间序列预测，而非空间分辨的推进过程，用条件流匹配对3小时间隔内的面积变化建模，输入为当前与前一步火场面积、空间平均气象、地形与可燃物组成。训练数据取自140组WRF-SFIRE耦合大气—野火模拟，并配对NAM气象场。单步预测相对WRF-SFIRE参考解的sMAPE为0.39;在12个留出案例上递归24小时多步预测的最终面积sMAPE同为0.39，并能给出预测不确定性量化，敏感性分析显示模型对风速、温度与相对湿度的响应符合物理规律。
arxiv.reason: 野火气象垂直应用，与LLM方向无交集

arxiv.title: Mixed Feelings, Single Polarity
arxiv.abstract: Emotion datasets are routinely mapped onto positive and negative valence, by assigning each emotion category one polarity. We test where this works and where it fails, using SemEval-2018 Affect in Tweets (English, Arabic, Spanish), Affective Text aligned with EmoBank, raw GoEmotions annotations, naturalistic hashtag corpora, and a controlled annotation study. Fixed projection works well when a text carries labels of one valence. It fails on a subset identifiable from the labels alone: tweets whose emotion labels point in opposite directions. These are 9.0% of polar SemEval test tweets but cause 54.8% of the polarity errors of a learned projection, are more than twice as likely to receive a neutral-or-mixed gold label, and are not rescued by modeling the full label set. Annotators produce such configurations routinely: 16.3% of multilabel GoEmotions judgments combine emotions from the dataset's own positive and negative parents. In a controlled study holding word and reader constant, context changes the coarse valence judgment in 56.8% of cases, against 19.9% for controls. We recommend projecting label configurations rather than labels, abstaining or keeping a mixed class where labels conflict, and reporting coverage alongside accuracy.
arxiv.titleZh: 混杂情感，单一极性
arxiv.summaryZh: 情感数据集通常把每个情绪类别固定投影为单一正负极性，该工作系统检验这种做法在何处失效，数据覆盖 SemEval-2018 Affect in Tweets(英、阿、西)、与 EmoBank 对齐的 Affective Text、GoEmotions 原始标注、自然 hashtag 语料及一项受控标注实验。标签指向相反方向的推文仅占极性测试集 9.0%，却造成学习式投影 54.8% 的极性错误，且获得中性或混合金标签的概率是其余样本的两倍以上;GoEmotions 多标签判断中 16.3% 混合正负父类，受控实验中语境令粗略极性判断改变的比例达 56.8%，对照组仅 19.9%。据此建议按标签配置而非单标签做投影，在标签冲突时弃权或保留混合类，并同时报告覆盖率与准确率。
arxiv.reason: 情感极性标注与投影研究，与 LLM 后训练及 Agent 方向基本无关

arxiv.title: PopGen: Generating Semantically Diverse Populations for Zero-Shot Coordination
arxiv.abstract: In multi-agent reinforcement learning, exposing a cooperator to partners with diverse strategies during training is key to better collaboration at test time. However, existing methods typically rely on trajectory-level proxies to measure diversity, which may label two distinct trajectories of the same strategy as diverse. Instead, our key insight is to leverage LLMs' ability to describe behaviorally distinct agents in environments, similar to how humans can recognize high-level strategies. To this end, we introduce PopGen, a framework that synthesizes semantically diverse agents from scratch using LLMs. PopGen first generates a diverse set of textual descriptions of agent behaviors, then translates each behavior into a code policy that can be executed within the environment. We show that cooperators trained against PopGen populations achieve robust zero-shot cooperation with unseen partners, outperforming population-play baselines across four collaborative environments. We further show that semantic diversity scales with PopGen population size, improving the cooperator's worst-case performance, and we identify design choices that preserve population quality while maximizing diversity. Our code is available at https://github.com/labicon/PopGen.
arxiv.titleZh: PopGen：为零样本协作生成语义多样的智能体种群
arxiv.summaryZh: 多智能体强化学习中，训练时让协作方接触策略各异的伙伴是测试时顺利合作的关键，但现有方法依赖轨迹层面的代理指标衡量多样性，容易把同一策略的两条不同轨迹误判为多样。PopGen 借助 LLM 识别高层行为策略的能力，先从零生成一批文本化的智能体行为描述，再把每条描述翻译成可在环境中执行的代码策略，从而直接合成语义多样的种群。在四个协作环境里，用 PopGen 种群训练的协作方对未见伙伴表现出稳健的零样本协作能力，超过 population-play 基线；语义多样性随种群规模增长，并改善协作方的最差情况表现。
arxiv.reason: LLM 合成多智能体种群，擦边 Agent 与多智能体方向

arxiv.title: Softmax-Free Attention in Spiking Transformers as the Zero-Temperature Limit of Two-Level Systems
arxiv.abstract: Spiking Transformers achieve energy efficiency by discarding softmax normalization in favor of thresholded, binary attention. However, this removal breaks the thermodynamic framework used to analyze attention networks, as the normalized measure and partition function cease to exist. We restore this theoretical foundation by proving that softmax-free spiking attention operates exactly as the zero-temperature limit of a product of independent two-level systems. This correspondence places spiking attention strictly in the frozen ordered phase of the thermodynamic phase diagram for all inputs. Consequently, the entropic cost of organizing attention collapses, replaced by a Landauer-type physical floor governed by action-potential generation. Furthermore, this ordered-phase pinning mathematically explains the optimization difficulty caused by vanishing surrogate gradients. We validate this theory with forward-relaxation experiments, placing both standard and neuromorphic attention mechanisms on a unified thermodynamic axis.
arxiv.titleZh: 脉冲 Transformer 中无 softmax 注意力作为二能级系统的零温极限
arxiv.summaryZh: 脉冲 Transformer 以阈值化二值注意力取代 softmax 归一化来换取能效，但归一化测度与配分函数不复存在，原有热力学分析框架随之失效。该工作证明无 softmax 的脉冲注意力恰好等价于一组独立二能级系统的零温极限，因而对所有输入都被严格钉在热力学相图的冻结有序相:组织注意力所需的熵代价坍缩，转由动作电位产生主导的 Landauer 型物理下界接管。这一有序相钉扎也从数学上解释了代理梯度消失带来的优化困难。前向弛豫实验把标准注意力与神经形态注意力放到同一条热力学坐标轴上验证。
arxiv.reason: 脉冲注意力理论分析偏物理，与主流 LLM 架构仅擦边

arxiv.title: Scaling Repeated-Data Pretraining: Batch Size, Regularization, and GPU-Time Tradeoffs
arxiv.abstract: We study pretraining when compute is abundant but unique training data are finite, requiring repeated training on the same data. We first revisit infinite-compute pretraining (Kim et al. 2026) and show that its frontier depends critically on choices previously fixed or studied only in isolation. In particular, optimizing batch size together with epoch counts reveals a U-shaped relationship between validation loss and batch size, favoring smaller batches than typical pretraining, likely because small-batch gradient noise provides implicit regularization. We further find that training recipes, previously optimized under a single-pass assumption, can be tuned, e.g., repacking documents into new sequences every epoch, weight tying, and positive embedding weight decay. We then relax the infinite-compute assumption. In particular, smaller-than-typical batch sizes can require prohibitively long sequential training, motivating to treat GPUs and time as separate resources. Tighter deadlines favor larger batches, and latency-oriented parallelism can trade additional GPUs for shorter training. Nevertheless, even under a fixed time budget, a smaller batch with fewer GPUs can achieve lower validation loss than a larger batch with more GPUs, challenging the common practice of increasing data parallelism to maximize GPU utilization under a deadline. Together, our results identify underexplored factors in repeated-data training and provide concrete guidance on how training recipes and resource allocation should change from single-pass pretraining.
arxiv.titleZh: 重复数据预训练的扩展:批大小、正则化与 GPU 时间权衡
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对算力充裕但唯一训练数据有限、必须反复训练同一批数据的场景，重新审视无限算力预训练的扩展前沿。联合优化批大小与 epoch 数后发现验证损失与批大小呈 U 形关系，最优批大小小于常规预训练取值，原因可能是小批量梯度噪声带来隐式正则;原先在单遍假设下调好的配方也需改变，如每轮重新打包文档序列、权重绑定、正嵌入权重衰减。进一步放松无限算力假设，把 GPU 与时间视为两种独立资源:紧 deadline 偏好大批量，而固定时间预算下小批量少 GPU 反而能取得更低验证损失，挑战了按 deadline 堆数据并行以拉满 GPU 利用率的常见做法。
arxiv.reason: 预训练配方与算力-数据权衡的系统性研究，命中架构与预训练方向

arxiv.title: Small but Mighty: Test Suites as Improvement Signals for Self-Evolving Agents
arxiv.abstract: A self-evolving agent rewrites its own harness and must decide which rewrites to keep, so its improvement signal is the check a rewrite has to pass. Verifying a rewrite by agent rollout is expensive and subjective, while executable checks such as the repository's own tests are too sparse to catch behavior-changing rewrites, rejecting only a quarter of them. We instead take test feedback as the executable signal, and search for test suites that are both small and strong with a quality-diversity evolutionary algorithm, so that the signal is dense and informative. TeSearch treats suite size as a behavior descriptor, so that quality is pursued at every size and a small, strong suite is reachable, and learns a transition kernel during the search that denoises the LLM as an actuator on that descriptor. Across 129 real-world modules and three backbones, TeSearch delivers the highest-quality suites of any method compared, LLM-driven evolutionary search included, and the smallest of any LLM-based one. Used as the improvement signal of a self-evolving agent, it rejects 59.9% of behavior-changing rewrites against 25.3% for the repository's tests, at a 4.0% false-alarm rate and 3.5 s per decision. The code and data are available at https://github.com/ccsnow127/TeSearch.
arxiv.comment: In NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Self-Evolving Diversity-Driven Search for Robust AI Systems (EvoRobust)
arxiv.titleZh: 小而强：测试套件作为自进化智能体的改进信号
arxiv.summaryZh: 自进化智能体改写自身 harness 后需决定保留哪些改写，用 agent rollout 验证代价高且主观，而仓库自带测试过于稀疏，只能拒掉约四分之一的行为变更改写。TeSearch 把测试反馈当作可执行信号，用质量-多样性进化算法搜索又小又强的测试套件：将套件规模设为行为描述符以在每个规模上追求质量，并在搜索中学习转移核，抑制 LLM 作为描述符执行器时的噪声。在 129 个真实模块与三个骨干模型上，其测试套件质量优于包括 LLM 驱动进化搜索在内的对比方法，规模在 LLM 类方法中最小；作为自进化智能体的改进信号，可拒掉 59.9% 的行为变更改写（仓库测试仅 25.3%），误报率 4.0%，单次决策 3.5 秒。
arxiv.reason: 自进化 Agent 的 harness 改进信号，命中 Agent 与自我改进方向

arxiv.title: Unfair and Unsafe: Everyday Bias Triggers Emergent Misalignment
arxiv.abstract: Emergent misalignment (EM) occurs when fine-tuning a language model to a narrow task makes it misaligned on unrelated ones. Because organizations now routinely fine-tune models on their own data, it matters which kinds of training data cause EM. So far, studies have induced EM with data containing recognized safety failures, such as insecure code or harmful advice, while biased training data is typically examined by fairness research for the bias models learn from it rather than for its effects on safety. In real-world text, much of this bias, such as demographic stereotypes, appears not as derogatory language but politely, embedded in judgments about people. We ask whether learning such polite stereotypes can itself cause EM. We find that fine-tuning on polite answers that rely on stereotypes makes models less safe and less truthful on unrelated tasks. The effect holds across four open-weight model families (7B to 12B), both gender and race stereotypes, and repeated training runs, relative to controls trained on the same questions without the stereotype. We further show that the learned stereotype has its own direction in model activations, distinct from directions for generic misaligned traits such as deception. This direction exists before fine-tuning and can both control the learned stereotype and monitor its acquisition. Existing defenses against EM improve safety while leaving the stereotype largely intact. Beyond this controlled setting, fine-tuning on political news coverage also triggers EM, apparently amplified by partisan framing, and stereotype models acting as tool-using agents can carry out harmful tasks and blame people without evidence. Our results show that biased training data is not only a fairness problem but also a safety one. We argue that EM is studied too narrowly, and that fairness concerns and methods offer a natural way to broaden the search for its triggers.
arxiv.titleZh: 不公平且不安全:日常偏见触发涌现性失准

arxiv.title: ADAPT: Audio-Depth Action Planning with Transition-Aware Rewards for Lights-Out Industrial Navigation
arxiv.abstract: Vision-language-action models for embodied navigation typically rely on RGB observations, limiting their applicability in lights-out industrial environments where visible illumination may be unavailable. We study illumination-independent navigation using spatial audio for target localization and depth for obstacle-aware geometry. To support this setting, we introduce DarkNav-Bench, a benchmark with 24 industrial scenes and four progressively challenging acoustic conditions. We further propose ADAPT, an audio-depth action-planning framework equipped with spatial-audio perception and optimized for closed-loop navigation through reinforcement learning (RL). Our key RL contribution, transition-aware reward shaping (TARS), defines a pose-aware shortest-action potential over a position-heading graph. Unlike conventional geodesic-progress rewards, TARS accounts for both feasible movements and in-place rotations, providing action-consistent feedback for policy optimization. Experiments show that ADAPT consistently outperforms training-based navigation baselines and zero-shot multimodal models on both seen and unseen scenes. On unseen environments, it achieves 90.6% success under Clean conditions and retains 60.0% success under the most challenging Localized Noise setting. These results demonstrate the potential of spatial audio and depth as complementary modalities for reliable RGB-free navigation in lights-out industrial environments.
arxiv.titleZh: ADAPT:面向熄灯工业导航的音频-深度动作规划与转场感知奖励

arxiv.title: Instance-Adaptive Online Multiclass Multicalibration
arxiv.abstract: We study online multiclass multicalibration over $T$ rounds, and give an algorithm with beyond-worst-case guarantees. With $n$ possible outcomes, forecasts lie in a simplex of dimension $d=n-1$. In the worst case, cumulative $\ell_1$ multicalibration error scales with $\widetildeΘ(T^{(d+1)/(d+2)})$, which becomes untenable once $d$ exceeds a small constant. Our algorithm adapts to the geometry of the realized sequence: if the sequence of adversarially selected outcome means lies in an affine subspace of dimension $s$, it obtains error $\widetilde O(n^{1/(s+2)}T^{(s+1)/(s+2)})$ with high probability. The algorithm adapts to this structure without knowing the subspace or its dimension. For $T\ge n\ge2$, this rate is minimax optimal up to polylogarithmic factors. For a stochastic instance with a fixed conditional mean, the bound specializes to $\widetilde O(\sqrt{nT})$, giving a square-root dependence on the horizon.
arxiv.titleZh: 实例自适应的在线多类多校准
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究 T 轮在线多类多校准问题:n 个结果时预测落在 d=n−1 维单纯形上，最坏情况下累积 ℓ1 多校准误差为 Θ̃(T^((d+1)/(d+2)))，维度稍增即不可用。新算法自适应实际序列的几何结构:若对抗选出的结果均值落在维度为 s 的仿射子空间内，误差降至 Õ(n^(1/(s+2))T^((s+1)/(s+2)))，且无需预先知道子空间及其维度。该速率在 T≥n≥2 时忽略多对数因子达到 minimax 最优，随机实例下退化为 Õ(√(nT))，对时间呈平方根依赖。
arxiv.reason: 纯在线学习校准理论，与 LLM 后训练/架构无直接关联

arxiv.title: Vision: "What Don't I Know About User's Preferences?" How Uncertainty Estimation Improves Proactive Assistant Alignment
arxiv.abstract: Proactive Smart Assistants (PSAs) increasingly use general knowledge, learned patterns from group-level data, patterns from individual user's data, and recent sensor observations to anticipate which action a user may prefer. Existing systems typically select actions from predicted user preference likelihoods, but these likelihoods alone do not reveal how reliable the prediction is, which evidence supports it, or why ambiguity remains. In this vision paper, we argue that uncertainty estimation can provide this missing information and substantially change appropriate downstream behavior. Using the example of a home assistant, we introduce the questions that uncertainty estimation aims to answer, i.e. how sure is the assistant about the predicted preference likelihood, whether the confidence come from group-level assumptions or individual's data, and whether likelihood ambiguity reflect the user's intrinsic preference variability or insufficient data for the particular situation. We further introduce uncertainty estimation applications in neighboring domains, such as human trajectory prediction, personalized activity recognition, information-collection, and model-based control. Finally, we draw on insights from neighboring domains to envision how future uncertainty-aware proactive assistants may address key challenges in proactive interaction.

arxiv.titleZh: 愿景:"我对用户偏好有哪些不了解?"不确定性估计如何改进主动式助手的对齐
arxiv.summaryZh: 主动式智能助手依据群体数据、个人数据与近期传感器观测预测用户偏好并据此选择动作，但预测似然本身无法说明预测有多可靠、证据来自何处、歧义为何存在。这篇愿景论文主张用不确定性估计补齐这些信息，提出三类问题:助手对预测偏好的确信度、置信来自群体假设还是个人数据、歧义源于用户偏好本身波动还是该情境数据不足，并借鉴人类轨迹预测、个性化活动识别、信息采集与基于模型的控制等邻近领域的经验，勾勒不确定性感知的主动式助手在主动交互上面临的关键挑战。文章为 workshop 愿景论文，不含具体方法与实验验证。

arxiv.title: Natural Language Processing for Aligning Readings with Learning Objectives and Assessing Topic Balance in Dental Education
arxiv.abstract: Curriculum teams often lack time to check whether assigned readings support learning objectives (LOs) and whether topic coverage is balanced. We present a natural language processing (NLP) workflow to support evidence-informed curation of reading lists. The workflow combines PubMedBERT sentence embeddings and cosine similarity for retrieval, natural language inference (NLI) for evidence checking, and topic modeling for coverage analysis. We tested the approach in dental education using 13 course-level LOs and a PubMed-derived corpus of 3,837 LO-abstract pairs. Median cosine similarity ranged from 0.86 to 0.91 across the 13 LOs, showing generally high semantic similarity. Topic modeling showed broad but uneven coverage, with one or two dominant topics per domain. Similarity alone was not enough for selecting readings: among high-similarity pairs (cosine 0.90-1.00), 22.9% were classified by NLI as neutral or contradictory. In a 49-pair expert-labeled validation set, cosine-based retrieval (cosine >= 0.90) achieved 0.69 accuracy, while the combined cosine and NLI approach achieved 0.73 accuracy against expert alignment labels. Overall, the workflow shows how AI can support curriculum alignment by reducing false positives and helping select readings that better match intended LOs.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向牙科教育的学习目标对齐与主题均衡评估的自然语言处理
arxiv.summaryZh: 课程团队往往无暇核查指定阅读材料是否支撑学习目标（LO）、主题覆盖是否均衡。该工作搭建了一套NLP流程：用PubMedBERT句向量与余弦相似度做检索，用自然语言推理（NLI）做证据校验，再用主题建模分析覆盖分布。在牙科教育场景下，以13条课程级LO和来自PubMed的3837个LO-摘要对测试，各LO的余弦相似度中位数为0.86至0.91，覆盖广但不均衡，每个领域有一到两个主导主题；相似度高并不足够，余弦在0.90至1.00的配对中有22.9%被NLI判为中立或矛盾，49对专家标注集上纯余弦检索准确率0.69，余弦叠加NLI为0.73。该流程通过降低假阳性辅助阅读清单的循证筛选，适用于教育等垂直场景。

arxiv.title: The Anatomy of a Blind Spot: What an LLM Judge Must Be Shown, and How Much
arxiv.abstract: Evaluation of text generated by large language models (LLMs) is increasingly delegated to LLMs acting as judges, yet what such a judge must be shown remains unresolved. We treat a judge whose reports are acted on as a regulator, in the sense of cybernetics, and ask what it must be shown, how much, in what form, and what its reports must get right. On seven public benchmarks we varied only what the judge was shown. Across three judges whose prices differ 10- to 17-fold, what the judge was shown mattered more than which judge it was. When a system revised its answers on feedback from a judge denied the material they had to respect, it ended below its starting point on instruction following and question answering. On instruction following the loss grew with each round, and it persisted when the judge saw the user's request but not the constraints and with a second judge family. On news summarisation, a correct reference summary beside the source undid most of the source's contribution, whereas on single-answer questions a reference helped. About a tenth of the source did almost all of its work, and a small entailment graph matched an LLM judge at finding errors in grounded text. We committed 83 testable clauses before running; of the 81 that ran, 32 met their bar and 50 went in the predicted direction, and most quantitative predictions from the theory failed. We report every shortfall and derive design rules tied to measured effects.
arxiv.titleZh: 盲点的解剖：LLM裁判必须被展示什么，以及展示多少
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM-as-judge评估中，裁判该看到哪些材料仍无共识。工作把裁判视为控制论意义上的调节器，在七个公开benchmark上固定裁判、只改变输入内容，并预先登记83条可检验命题。结果显示：价格相差10–17倍的三类裁判之间，输入内容的影响大于裁判本身；被剥夺必要约束的裁判反馈使系统在指令遵循与问答上低于起点，且损失逐轮累积；摘要任务中并列参考摘要抵消了源文档的大部分作用，单答案问答中参考反而有益；约十分之一的源文本承担了几乎全部作用，小型蕴含图在定位有依据文本的错误上可媲美LLM裁判。工作给出与实测效应绑定的裁判输入设计规则，可用于评测流水线与自我修订循环。
arxiv.reason: LLM-as-judge输入设计的系统研究，直击评测可靠性

arxiv.title: Error-Based Bidirectional Predictive Coding Enables Deep, 4-Bit Predictive Coding Networks
arxiv.abstract: Predictive coding networks (PCNs) promise properties not offered by backpropagation-trained networks: learning from purely local information, a single network that both discriminates and generates, and flexible inference by energy minimization. However, their iterative inference is expensive, making hardware acceleration desirable, and a useful, efficient accelerator needs both depth and aggressive quantization. Canonical state-based PC delivers neither: its inference signal decays exponentially with depth, so deep models fail to train, and low precision makes it worse. We show that pairing two recent methods carries the full PCN property set into the deep, 4-bit regime: bidirectional PC (bPC), which unifies discrimination and generation, and the error-based reparameterization (ePC), which optimizes prediction errors rather than states during inference. Error optimization delivers the output signal to every layer in a single backward pass, removing the signal decay; one additional element, global-norm clipping of the error gradients, stabilizes the error dynamics at depth. The resulting ePC+bPC model trains stably up to at least eight layers and retains its full-precision accuracy and clean class-conditional generation under W4A4E4 quantization-aware training, across FP4 and three posit formats. On six-layer networks, where state-based bPC collapses to chance, ePC+bPC classifies more than 50 accuracy points above it after one epoch of training, with class-conditional generations 5-9x better in RMSE. 4-bit quantization is nearly free: full-precision and 4-bit accuracies differ by at most ~5 points, and by under two in the best-performing formats. We characterize the two failure modes the method overcomes, bounded signal decay in state-based PC and error divergence in unregularized error optimization, and discuss implications for a 4-bit-native PCN accelerator.
arxiv.titleZh: 基于误差的双向预测编码实现深层、4-bit预测编码网络
arxiv.summaryZh: 预测编码网络可纯局部学习、判别与生成合一，但迭代推理昂贵，硬件加速需要深度加激进量化;标准基于状态的PC推理信号随深度指数衰减，深层模型训练失败，低精度更差。方法把双向PC(bPC)与基于误差的重参数化(ePC)结合:推理时优化预测误差而非状态，一次反向传播即把输出信号送达每层，消除衰减，并以误差梯度的全局范数裁剪稳定深层误差动态。结果可稳定训练至少八层，在W4A4E4量化感知训练下(FP4与三种posit格式)保住全精度准确率与类条件生成;六层网络上基于状态的bPC退化为随机，ePC+bPC训练一个epoch后分类精度高出50个点以上，类条件生成RMSE好5–9倍，全精度与4-bit精度差最多约5点，最佳格式下不到2点。

arxiv.title: DiffNash: Finding Nash Equilibrium in High-Dimensional Continuous Action Spaces with Diffusion Policies
arxiv.abstract: Computing equilibria in high-dimensional continuous games requires learning and representing rich, multi-modal strategy distributions, something conventional neural policies struggle to achieve. Diffusion models offer a natural solution, but standard diffusion training requires direct samples from a fixed target distribution, which are generally unavailable under iterative game-solving updates. We propose a diffusion-based framework for equilibrium computation that enables diffusion-based variants of Online Mirror Descent (OMD) and Fictitious Play (FP). Our approach derives a reweighted score-matching objective that trains diffusion policies without requiring direct samples from each updated policy. Our main method, DiffNash, combines the fast convergence of OMD with the sample efficiency of FP by reusing past actions through a replay buffer. To correct the resulting distribution shift from sample reuse, we derive an unbiased estimator of the difference between current and past policies' Evidence Lower Bounds, whose exponential provides a tractable proxy for the corresponding importance weight without evaluating diffusion likelihoods. We evaluate our approach on forest protection games and continuous Colonel Blotto games, reducing the Nash gap over the strongest baseline by 35.6% and 24.7%, respectively, with minimal hyperparameter tuning.
arxiv.titleZh: DiffNash:用扩散策略在高维连续动作空间中求解纳什均衡
arxiv.summaryZh: 高维连续博弈的均衡求解需要表达多模态策略分布，传统神经策略难以胜任，而标准扩散训练依赖固定目标分布的直接采样，在迭代式博弈求解中并不可得。该工作推导重加权 score matching 目标，使扩散策略无需从更新后的策略直接采样即可训练，并给出 Online Mirror Descent 与 Fictitious Play 的扩散版本。主方法 DiffNash 用回放缓冲复用历史动作，兼顾 OMD 的收敛速度与 FP 的样本效率，并以当前与历史策略 ELBO 之差的无偏估计作为重要性权重代理，修正样本复用带来的分布偏移。在森林保护博弈与连续 Colonel Blotto 博弈上，Nash gap 较最强基线分别降低 35.6% 与 24.7%。

arxiv.title: Mesh-Free Convolution: Learned Spectral Attenuation and Transport
arxiv.abstract: Learning solution operators for partial differential equations (PDEs) requires models that can represent spatial structure across grids and scales. This becomes especially important in time-dependent problems, where the learned operator is often used autoregressively: each predicted state is fed back as input to predict future states. In this setting, small spatial errors can be repeatedly propagated through the learned dynamics, leading to instability and drift, vitiating long-term solution fidelity. We propose Mesh-Free Convolutions (MFCs), filters defined in continuous space and discretized only at evaluation time. This allows the same learned filters to be applied across resolutions. Rather than imposing a grid-dependent stencil or a fixed spectral cutoff, MFCs learn smooth scale-dependent filtering and include directional terms for transport-like behavior. Across fluid-dynamics and weather-forecasting benchmarks, MFC-based models produce stable long-horizon rollouts, transfer reliably across resolutions, and better preserve long-time statistics. These results suggest that continuous, mesh-free filtering is a useful inductive bias for PDE operator learning, especially in autoregressive prediction.
arxiv.titleZh: 无网格卷积:学习式谱衰减与输运
arxiv.summaryZh: 求解偏微分方程(PDE)解算子需要模型跨网格与尺度表示空间结构，而时间依赖问题中算子常被自回归使用，预测状态反复回灌，微小空间误差被持续放大，造成不稳定与漂移。MFC 将滤波器定义在连续空间、仅在求值时离散化，使同一组学习到的滤波器可跨分辨率复用;它不依赖网格模板或固定谱截断，而是学习平滑的尺度相关滤波，并加入方向性项以刻画输运行为。在流体力学与天气预报基准上，基于 MFC 的模型能稳定长时程滚动预测，跨分辨率迁移可靠，并更好地保持长时间统计特性，说明连续无网格滤波是 PDE 算子学习的有效归纳偏置。

arxiv.title: Multi-Horizon Explainable Queue Forecasting and Resource-Aware Decision Support for Intelligent Border Control Using LightGBM
arxiv.abstract: Border crossing points are stochastic service systems in which traffic demand, traveler categories, registration status, inspection requirements, staffing, and lane availability interact on multiple time scales. This paper extends an earlier multimodal queue-management framework by introducing an implementation-oriented, multi-horizon forecasting and decision-support architecture based on Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM) models. In contrast to a single forecasting block, the proposed approach constructs horizon-specific regressors for 15, 30, 60, and 120 min forecasts and jointly estimates future waiting time and queue lengths. The models operate on temporally lagged traffic, service, density, and queue features, while an operational layer incorporates lane compatibility, officer availability, possibly degraded resources, traveler category, preregistration information, and human-approval constraints. Quantile LightGBM models provide 95\% prediction intervals for waiting-time forecasts. Beyond prediction, the framework produces machine-readable recommendations, alerts, aggregate key performance indicators, confidence information, and integration outputs suitable for border resource-management and decision-support systems. The results establish a reproducible synthetic-data baseline and a practical interface for subsequent validation with operational border-crossing data.
arxiv.titleZh: 基于LightGBM的多时间跨度可解释排队预测与资源感知决策支持:面向智能边境管控

arxiv.title: Fast and Accurate: Improving Personalized LLM Performance by Semantic Concentration Inspired Workload Split between RAG and Fine-Tuning
arxiv.abstract: With ever increasing personalized large language model (LLM) services, the next question to answer is how to improve the quality of services/users' experiences, which is indicated by personalized LLM generation accuracy/quality and inference latency. Although state-of-the-art designs, e.g., parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) or Full PEFT+RAG, can help, they largely ignore the heterogeneous semantic concentrations of users' historical data and cannot fully unleash the potential of personal data for personalized LLM performance enhancement. In this paper, we propose PEFT Union RAG (PUR), a novel ``fast and accurate'' approach that exploits the semantic concentration of users' personal historical data to split workload between PEFT and RAG, aiming to improve personalized LLM performance in terms of better generation accuracy/quality and lower inference latency. Briefly, PUR partitions user's personal historical data and assigns semantic concentrated ``core'' information to PEFT for offline parametric fine-tuning, while retaining dispersed information for RAG. During the online LLM inference, PUR directly generates responses for ``core'' queries covered by the PEFT region and invokes RAG only for sporadic ``peripheral'' queries. Experimental results show that, by appropriately splitting workload between PEFT and RAG, PUR consistently achieves the best generation accuracy/quality for various users across multiple tasks, while reducing inference latency by 14.4%--46.6% compared with the best performed method.
arxiv.titleZh: 快且准:以语义集中度启发的工作负载切分在 RAG 与微调之间提升个性化 LLM 性能
arxiv.summaryZh: 个性化 LLM 服务中，用户历史数据的语义分布高度不均，而现有 PEFT、RAG 或二者直接叠加的方案忽视了这种异构性，难以充分释放个人数据的价值。PUR 按语义集中度切分工作负载:把语义集中的「核心」信息交给 PEFT 做离线参数微调，分散信息留给 RAG;在线推理时核心查询由微调模型直接生成，仅零星边缘查询触发检索。在多个任务、多位用户上取得最佳生成质量，推理延迟相比最优基线降低 14.4%–46.6%。
arxiv.reason: RAG 与微调的工作负载切分，偏系统效率，属增量改进

arxiv.title: Sample-Optimal Multi-Group Learning with an ERM Oracle
arxiv.abstract: In multi-group learning, a single predictor must perform nearly as well as the best hypothesis in a class on every group in a rich, possibly infinite and overlapping, collection of subpopulations. The known algorithms with the optimal sample complexity keep track of every pair of a group and a hypothesis, which is impossible for the large classes of interest, and the known oracle-based algorithms have a worse rate. We ask whether the optimal rate can be attained by a learner that accesses the classes only through an empirical risk minimization (ERM) oracle. We give an algorithm that uses $\tilde{O}((d_G+d_H)/\varepsilon^2)$ samples and polynomially many calls to a weighted ERM oracle over pairs of a group and a hypothesis, where $d_G$ and $d_H$ are the VC dimensions of the group and hypothesis classes and $\varepsilon$ bounds the excess risk on every group, weighted by its probability. We also show a matching lower bound of $Ω((d_G+d_H)/\varepsilon^2)$ samples for every learner even with unlimited computation, so oracle efficiency costs no additional samples. We also consider a natural special case in which every input belongs to at most $k$ groups and these groups can be listed. In this case, an ERM oracle for the hypothesis class alone suffices, with $\tilde{O}((d_H+\log k)/\varepsilon^2)$ samples in the agnostic setting and $\tilde{O}((d_H+\log k)/\varepsilon)$ samples when every group has a hypothesis that is correct on it.
arxiv.titleZh: 基于 ERM 预言机的样本最优多组学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 多组学习要求单一预测器在每个子群体上都接近最优假设的表现，而已有达到最优样本复杂度的算法需枚举所有（组，假设）对，难以用于大规模类别。该工作改以加权 ERM 预言机访问组与假设类，给出使用 Õ((d_G+d_H)/ε²) 样本、多项式次调用的算法，并证明 Ω((d_G+d_H)/ε²) 下界，说明预言机效率不额外增加样本。在每组输入至多属于 k 个可列举组的特例下，仅用假设类本身的 ERM 预言机即可达到 Õ((d_H+log k)/ε²) 与 Õ((d_H+log k)/ε) 的样本量。
arxiv.reason: 纯学习理论学习，与 LLM 及后训练方向无关

arxiv.title: More Reasoning Is Not Always Better: Executing Clinical Guidelines with LLMs and Rules
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown considerable promise in clinical decision support. However, existing approaches often rely on multi-step reasoning or multi-agent collaboration to execute clinical guidelines, introducing substantial computational overhead without reliably preventing decision errors. To address these limitations, we propose a framework for Medical Decision Execution (MedDEx) that integrates structured patient states with deterministic rule execution to support guideline-based treatment planning. MedDEx separates clinical record interpretation from guideline execution, leveraging LLMs to extract patient information and generate treatment plans while assigning guideline-defined decision logic to a rule executor. Experiments across multiple clinical guideline benchmarks demonstrate that MedDEx improves decision accuracy while reducing inference costs. Further analyses highlight the critical roles of structured patient representations and deterministic rule execution, suggesting that additional LLM reasoning does not necessarily translate into better guideline adherence.
arxiv.titleZh: 更多推理并不总是更好：用LLM与规则执行临床指南
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对临床指南执行依赖多步推理与多智能体协作、计算开销大且难以可靠避免决策错误的问题，提出MedDEx框架，将临床记录理解与指南执行解耦：由LLM抽取患者信息并生成治疗方案，指南定义的决策逻辑交由确定性规则执行器，并以结构化患者状态衔接两者。在多个临床指南基准上，MedDEx在提升决策准确率的同时降低推理成本；分析表明结构化患者表示与确定性规则执行起关键作用，额外的LLM推理未必带来更好的指南依从性。
arxiv.reason: 医疗垂直应用，仅与LLM推理及规则混合思路沾边

arxiv.title: RIVO: Lightweight Adaptive Rerouting for Deep Research Agents
arxiv.abstract: Deep Research agents rely on long-horizon reasoning and iterative tool use to solve complex information-seeking tasks. However, adaptive decision-making over these trajectories remains challenging, as agents may stop prematurely when further evidence is needed, continue unnecessarily after sufficient evidence has been gathered, or fail to redirect unproductive trajectories. Existing solutions either require costly model retraining and dense turn-level supervision, or rely on heuristic control rules that are not directly optimized for downstream research utility. This motivates a lightweight, utility-aware alternative for Deep Research control. We formulate adaptive rerouting in long-horizon Deep Research as a state-conditioned trajectory correction problem. Based on this view, we introduce RIVO, a lightweight plug-in framework for adaptive trajectory correction. The agent estimates its research state from lightweight signals and determines whether trajectory redirection is needed. Once triggered, the plug-in modifies the Host token logits to steer generation toward a more promising research direction. Theoretical analysis shows that, under a value-alignment condition and bounded local curvature, a sufficiently small logit intervention can locally improve expected downstream research utility. We further construct BrowseCore, a curated dataset with a paired local corpus, for efficient and controlled Deep Research experimentation. Building on this resource, the plug-in is trained from downstream outcomes, enabling it to learn corrections that improve subsequent research and final task performance. Extensive experiments across multiple Deep Research benchmarks and control settings demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, showing that lightweight logit intervention can improve long-horizon research without retraining the underlying Host model.
arxiv.titleZh: RIVO:面向深度研究智能体的轻量自适应改道
arxiv.summaryZh: 长程Deep Research智能体常在证据不足时过早停止、证据充分后仍继续，或无法纠正无效轨迹，而现有方案或依赖昂贵的重训练与密集轮级监督，或使用未针对下游研究收益优化的启发式规则。RIVO将自适应改道建模为状态条件化的轨迹修正问题，用轻量信号估计研究状态并判断是否触发，触发后直接修改Host模型的token logits以引导生成，无需重训主体模型;理论分析表明在价值对齐与有界局部曲率条件下，足够小的logit干预可局部提升期望研究效用。配套构建BrowseCore数据集与本地语料，并直接从下游结果训练该插件，在多个Deep Research基准与多种控制设置上验证了有效性。
arxiv.reason: 深度研究智能体的免训练轨迹控制，命中Agent方向

arxiv.title: LURE: a Phase-Labelled Synthetic Corpus of Online-Grooming Exchanges
arxiv.abstract: Phase-annotated conversational data is essential for studying the progression of online grooming of minors and for developing early warning tools. However, the only publicly available source (i.e., Perverted-Justice archive, which contains a subset coded using ChatCoder) is small, outdated, and frozen. We present a synthetic corpus of groomer-victim exchanges, generated using a retrieval-augmented pipeline running on institutional hardware. This pipeline uses an openly available, eight-billion-parameter, refusal-ablated language model. The corpus was created using the five stages of the responsible-generation protocol for synthetic datasets: ontology-driven design based on the ChatCoder luring-communication scheme (eight communicative tags mapped onto four grooming phases); multi-model prompt testing; human-in-the-loop supervision; semantic and feature-level validation; and modality-aware documentation. The released corpus contains 2,121 unique exchanges across seven tags and four phases, each accompanied by a Plutchik emotion field. Validation quantifies the integrity and lexical profile of the corpus, as well as the reproduction of real seed lines, in-domain label recoverability (tag accuracy: 0.85; phase accuracy: 0.93) and its transfer to real ChatCoder offender lines, which were coded automatically at the eight-tag level (31,640 lines) and by human coders at the three-construct level (10,876 posts). Accuracy was measured for lexical and sentence-embedding features, while a real-versus-synthetic discriminator was able to separate the two domains with 91% accuracy. The scope of the corpus includes controlled, phase-conditioned experimentation, pipeline development and augmentation alongside real data and awareness material. The corpus, its datasheet and the audit code are released with vetted access.
arxiv.titleZh: LURE:一个按阶段标注的在线诱骗对话合成语料库
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对未成年人网络诱骗研究缺乏公开的阶段标注对话数据(现有归档规模小、陈旧且冻结)，构建合成语料库LURE:检索增强流水线驱动开源80亿参数、去除拒答的模型生成诱骗者—受害者对话，遵循本体驱动设计、多模型提示测试、人在回路监督、语义与特征级验证、模态感知文档五阶段协议。语料含2,121组对话，覆盖7个标签与4个阶段，每条附Plutchik情绪字段;域内标签准确率0.85、阶段准确率0.93，可迁移至真实ChatCoder犯罪者语句，但真实/合成判别器仍以91%准确率区分两域。
arxiv.reason: LLM合成数据流水线，但面向儿童保护垂直应用，方向擦边

arxiv.title: Review Rarely Beats the Stronger Model: Separating Verification from Capability Transfer in LLM Pipelines
arxiv.abstract: Qwen3-8B reviewing Llama-3.1-8B in math adds 33.2 points, yet Qwen3-8B alone is 6.4 points more accurate than the result. Reviewing another model's answer is usually judged by its gain over the generator. We show that this confuses verification, which adds accuracy beyond either model alone, with capability transfer, where a stronger reviewer supplies answers it could have given on its own. Measured against the stronger model alone, across 48 pairs of 12 open-weight models (3B to 72B) in math, knowledge, code and reasoning, review beats it in only 9 of 96 review directions, and does worse the larger the capability gap. The reason is that the reviewer mostly follows the generator, discarding its own correct answers. Review costs 2.6 to 2.8 times as much as the stronger model alone, while a selector using the same two calls is 2.7 to 4.2 points more accurate than review and cheaper. Studies of verification should report the stronger model alone, not only the gain over the generator. Code and per-question results: https://github.com/Kamilaabb/verification-or-capability-transfer
arxiv.titleZh: 评审很少能胜过更强的模型:在 LLM 流水线中区分验证与能力迁移
arxiv.summaryZh: 以相对生成器的提升来评判让一个模型审阅另一个模型答案的做法，会把两件事混为一谈:验证，即真正超出任一单模型的准确率增益;能力迁移，即更强的审阅者只是给出它独自本就能给出的答案。在 12 个开源模型(3B–72B)组成的 48 对组合、覆盖数学、知识、代码与推理的 96 个审阅方向上，审阅仅在 9 个方向胜过单独使用更强模型，且能力差距越大表现越差，原因是审阅者大多跟随生成器、丢弃自己的正确答案。审阅成本是单模型的 2.6–2.8 倍，而用同样两次调用做选择器则高出 2.7–4.2 分且更便宜，提示验证类研究应以更强模型单独作为报告基线。
arxiv.reason: LLM 互评与评估方法学，揭示验证基线设定缺陷，实验系统扎实

arxiv.title: Make Every Expansion Count: Learning to Search Efficiently in LLM Code Repair
arxiv.abstract: Large language model (LLM) code-repair systems fix faulty programs by repeatedly generating and testing revisions. Each revision is costly, making the choice of which repair to pursue important for efficiency. Existing search policies rely on test pass rates and search statistics, ignoring the details of test failures and proposed edits. We introduce CodeTriage, a learned policy that prioritizes edits before their revised programs are generated and tested. Its 0.6B-parameter model reads the test output, failure diagnosis, and proposed edit, then predicts a distribution over the number of repair steps needed to reach a fix through that edit. These predictions prioritize all pending edits across programs before generating and testing the revised code. On held-out repair tasks, CodeTriage finds fixes with 21% fewer program revisions and 12% fewer output tokens than the strongest baseline on each metric. Without retraining, it achieves the highest average success across search budgets for each of 11 unseen repair LLMs. Ablations show that both the failure context and edit text, as well as comparisons across programs, improve search. We also release a corpus of 12.2 million program versions from four LLMs, organized into repair trees with proposed edits and test results.
arxiv.titleZh: 让每一次扩展都算数:在 LLM 代码修复中学习高效搜索
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM 代码修复系统靠反复生成并测试修订来修 bug，每次修订代价高昂，选择哪条修复路径直接决定效率。现有搜索策略只用测试通过率和搜索统计，忽略测试失败细节与所提编辑的内容。CodeTriage 用一个 0.6B 参数模型读取测试输出、失败诊断与候选编辑，预测经由该编辑达到修复所需的修复步数分布，从而在生成与测试代码之前对所有程序的待处理编辑统一排序。在留出修复任务上，它比最强基线少 21% 的程序修订、少 12% 的输出 token，且无需重训练即可在 11 个未见修复 LLM 上取得各搜索预算下最高的平均成功率;消融表明失败上下文、编辑文本与跨程序比较均有增益。作者同时发布 1220 万条程序版本的修复树语料，含所提编辑与测试结果。
arxiv.reason: 代码修复搜索策略，命中代码智能与 Agent 效率方向，数据充实

arxiv.title: Variance-Optimal State Resampling for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards spends much of its rollout budget on states that yield no learning signal. We recast this as a question about the sampling distribution itself: under a fixed rollout budget, which distribution over states minimizes the variance of the policy-gradient estimator? The answer admits a closed-form Neyman allocation, $μ_{\mathrm{var}}^π(s) \propto d^π(s)\,σ_π(s)$, which connects naturally to GRPO's group-relative advantage and induces an emergent reverse curriculum as the policy improves, with no externally imposed schedule. Building on this principle, we propose VSR (Variance-driven State Resampling), a plug-in modification to GRPO using a prefix replay buffer and a zero-cost variance proxy. On mathematical reasoning benchmarks and long-horizon agentic tasks (Sokoban, BabyAI), VSR outperforms GRPO and GiGPO on most benchmarks with fewer generated tokens per update.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向可验证奖励强化学习的方差最优状态重采样
arxiv.summaryZh: 可验证奖励 RL 常把大量 rollout 预算花在几乎不产生学习信号的状态上。该工作把问题重新表述为采样分布的选择：在固定 rollout 预算下最小化策略梯度估计方差，得到闭式 Neyman 分配 μ_var(s) ∝ d^π(s)σ_π(s)，并与 GRPO 的组内相对优势自然衔接，随策略提升自发形成逆向课程而无需外部调度。据此提出的 VSR 以 prefix replay buffer 与零成本方差代理作为 GRPO 的即插即用改造，在数学推理基准与 Sokoban、BabyAI 等长程 Agent 任务上多数超过 GRPO 和 GiGPO，且每次更新所需生成 token 更少。
arxiv.reason: RLVR 采样分布理论 + GRPO 改进，命中后训练方向

arxiv.title: Comparative Study of Canvas- and Coordinate-Based Geometry-Conditioned Neural Networks for Real-Time Prediction of Indoor Environments with Varying Room Dimensions
arxiv.abstract: Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) is computationally expensive for iterative building design. Deep learning surrogates offer faster predictions, but generalization across varying room dimensions remains challenging. This study compares two geometry-conditioned neural network surrogate models for rapid indoor airflow and temperature field prediction under varying room sizes. During the architectural design stage, this method is relevant for real-time assessment of whether conditioned supply air will effectively provide fresh and cool air throughout rooms with varying heights and lengths. The canvas-based neural network (CaNN) explicitly encodes room size by preserving different occupied regions within a fixed canvas, whereas the coordinate-based neural network (CoNN) uses normalized coordinate channels. Both employ U-Net autoencoders to separately predict airflow and temperature fields. Evaluation uses simplified rooms with varying heights and lengths as a controlled benchmark. The results show that CaNN achieves higher agreement with CFD results than CoNN, demonstrating its potential to support performance-driven building design.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向不同房间尺寸实时室内环境预测的基于画布与基于坐标的几何条件神经网络对比研究
arxiv.summaryZh: 为降低迭代式建筑设计对CFD的依赖，对比两种几何条件神经网络代理模型，用于不同房间尺寸下室内气流与温度场的快速预测。CaNN在固定画布中保留不同占用区域以显式编码房间尺寸，CoNN则使用归一化坐标通道，两者均以U-Net自编码器分别预测气流场与温度场，并在高度与长度可变的简化房间上评测。结果显示CaNN与CFD结果的一致性高于CoNN，可用于性能驱动的建筑设计中送风效果的实时评估。
arxiv.reason: 室内CFD代理建模，属建筑垂直应用，偏离LLM方向

arxiv.title: RetryBench: Separating Retry Permission from Recovery Outcomes in GPT Tool Use
arxiv.abstract: False retry permission (FRP) occurs when an agent retries a timed-out tool call without support from the visible contract. RetryBench separates this error from realized recovery. Successful protected recovery does not imply reliable rejection of unsupported retries. In a 720-response key control, valid keys usually enabled safe progress, but offered changed keys elicited unsupported retries in Sol (1/80), Terra (55/80), and Luna (60/80). A later 240-response control removed the candidate and required models to supply a key. Luna still made 8/80 unsupported dispatches; Sol and Terra made none in 80 responses each. Accepting a displayed bad key therefore cannot explain all observed errors, although changed output requirements and conditions preclude a pure display-effect comparison. Removing the weak-contract label increased retries in Sol and Terra's coded-action conditions in a six-endpoint study. A separate 1,536-response canonical-action block also found a positive Terra contrast (115/128 versus 124/128 retries), concentrated in two task/order conditions; the other five contrasts remained unresolved after multiplicity correction. An explicit-contract cue control elicited deferral in all 762 returned responses, leaving recovery unresolved. These results support reporting permission and recovery together across declared interface variants. The evidence covers four purposive tasks, fixed GPT endpoints, and one recovery decision; it identifies neither internal mechanisms nor episode-level safety.
arxiv.titleZh: RetryBench:将重试许可与恢复结果分离的 GPT 工具使用评测
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对智能体在工具超时后重试的行为，提出虚假重试许可(FRP)概念:智能体在可见契约未授权时仍重试超时调用，且这一错误与真实的恢复结果需分开度量。RetryBench 在 GPT 端点上做受控实验:720 条密钥控制中合法密钥多能安全推进，换成被改动的密钥后 Sol、Terra、Luna 分别出现 1/80、55/80、60/80 次无依据重试;随后 240 条要求模型自带密钥的控制中，Luna 仍有 8/80 次无依据派发，Sol 与 Terra 为 0。去掉弱契约标签会提高 Sol 与 Terra 的重试率，规范动作实验中 Terra 的重试对比为 115/128 对 124/128。结论主张重试许可与恢复结果应一并报告，但证据仅覆盖四个任务、固定端点与单一恢复决策。
arxiv.reason: Agent 工具调用重试行为的评测，命中 Agent 与评测方向，选题偏细

arxiv.title: Engram Injection: A Study of Temporal Validity in Parametric Language-Model Memory
arxiv.abstract: A stored fact may stop being valid when a user changes a preference or an event replaces an earlier one. We study whether a language model can learn these changes in its parameters and answer correctly from only a question and the current time. Engram Injection stores facts in LoRA adapters and supplies the clock through FiLM conditioning on a frozen Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct model. We compare it with additive clock conditioning, prompting with the full dated history, and retrieving four dated records. We train six matched adapters across three seeds after fixing a sampler that could admit test-age examples into training. The training audit reports no such examples among 127,760 evaluated training inputs. On 62 pairs of questions asked before and after an update, at an elapsed age of seven days excluded from training, both adapter methods answer zero pairs correctly under the primary blinded assistant review with order code 1 held fixed. Full-history prompting answers 59/62 pairs correctly, and retrieval answers 62/62. Separate experiments show that adapters can store facts and that removable memory units can support local deletion. Combining fact selection with time-based version selection remains unsuccessful. These results separate learning a fact from learning when to use it.
arxiv.titleZh: Engram Injection：参数化语言模型记忆的时间有效性研究
arxiv.summaryZh: 论文关注参数化记忆的时间有效性：当用户偏好改变或事件被后来者取代时，模型能否只凭问题和当前时间给出答案。方法把事实写入 LoRA 适配器，并以 FiLM 对冻结的 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 注入时钟信号，与加法式时钟条件、完整带日期历史提示、检索四条带日期记录三种方案对比。在训练中未出现的七天时间年龄上，62 对更新前后问题中两种适配器方法均零对正确，完整历史提示答对 59/62，检索答对 62/62。结果把「学会事实」与「学会何时使用该事实」区分开来，说明现有参数化记忆方案尚难承担时间版本选择。
arxiv.reason: 参数化记忆的时间有效性，负结果扎实但非核心方向

arxiv.title: Unchecked or Falsely Accused? Evaluating AI-Generated Text Detectors on Kazakh
arxiv.abstract: AI-text detectors are already applied to Kazakh writing, yet no study reports how often publicly available detectors flag Kazakh text whose human authorship is dated before ChatGPT. We present AINA-KK: 3,811 human passages from encyclopedic, news, web and educational pages that provably existed before ChatGPT, and 5,597 machine and gray-zone passages from 9 generators, including the Kazakh-built KazLLM and Sherkala, with script and length stress tests. Five English-trained detectors from the Hugging Face Hub flag up to 81.4% of human passages and 79.6% of published student essays; recalibrated, they catch at most 1.3% of machine text. Calibrated zero-shot detectors catch at most 50.3% of machine text from in-distribution generators. Fine-tuned encoders rank text almost perfectly, but mDeBERTa at its default threshold flags 24.4% of 50-word human excerpts, partly because machine outputs are shorter than human text; calibrated, it catches only 47.1% of KazLLM and 62.7% of Sherkala passages. Without script handling, machine-transliterated Latin-2021 text defeats every detector. Fixes that need no new data (calibration, script canonicalization, script-augmented and length-matched training, and an OR with a zero-shot scorer) form AINA-KK-Det. On test it flags 0.9% of human passages (95% CI 0.4-2.7; 1.5% on development data) and catches 85.2% of machine text from known generators, 92.9% from two unseen Gemini-family Gemma-4 models and 61.3% from the Kazakh-built ones; its configuration was chosen with test results in view. We release the data, code and detector at https://github.com/ozxmn/aina-kk.

arxiv.titleZh: 未被查出还是被误判?在哈萨克语上评测AI生成文本检测器

arxiv.title: Personalized LLM Recommendation with Semantic IDs: Autoregressive Beam Search vs. Multi-Token Prediction
arxiv.abstract: Large-scale personalization is shifting from embedding-table retrieval to LLM-based recommenders that generate the Semantic ID (SID) of the item to recommend, where each SID is a short sequence of discrete hierarchical content codes. A single instruction-tuned model can then unify retrieval, content understanding, and language, and recommend brand-new titles from their content alone using SID; then, how should the model generate the SID? Traditionally, models rely on a single language modeling head that generates tokens autoregressively, typically using constrained beam search. In contrast, an emerging body of work explores multi-token prediction (MTP), where dedicated heads predict all tokens in parallel, substantially reducing the decoding latency associated with beam search. We report an industry-scale, apples-to-apples comparison of these two generation paradigms: single-head autoregressive decoding vs. MTP. We introduce a new auxiliary ranking loss, defined over the joint SID score, to train the MTP objective. We evaluate the SID training objectives on both quality and training/inference cost, inside a multi-task LLM that jointly does personalized retrieval, content question-answering (QA), and instruction following over a large streaming-media catalog. Our experiments show single-head beam search consistently beats MTP on most product-critical metrics: ranking and content QA, and trains at roughly 2.6x lower dollar cost on Qwen3-8B scale; MTP wins only on raw inference throughput. Around this finding, we detail an efficient training and inference stack and report end-to-end gains over the previous non-SID baseline equipped with an auxiliary ranking head: +77% item cold-start ranking, +22% content-QA accuracy, +2.8x faster training, with language metric regression traced to SID vocabulary expansion. We address the language regression by reinforcement learning post training.
arxiv.titleZh: 个性化 LLM 推荐中的 Semantic ID:自回归 Beam Search 与多 Token 预测的对比
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM 推荐器通过生成物品的 Semantic ID(SID，即层级化离散内容编码序列)来完成检索，但 SID 该用单头自回归加约束 beam search 生成，还是用多头并行预测(MTP)，缺少同等条件下的对比。作者在 Qwen3-8B 规模的多任务 LLM 上做了工业级对照，并为 MTP 目标设计了定义在联合 SID 分数上的辅助排序损失，同时评测排序、内容 QA 与指令遵循的质量及训练/推理成本。结果显示单头 beam search 在排序与内容 QA 等关键指标上稳定胜出，训练成本约为 MTP 的 1/2.6,MTP 仅在原始推理吞吐上占优;相对此前带辅助排序头的非 SID 基线，物品冷启动排序提升 77%，内容 QA 准确率提升 22%，训练快 2.8 倍，语言指标退化经 RL 后训练修复。
arxiv.reason: MTP 与自回归解码的对照属架构效率方向，但落点是推荐系统应用

arxiv.title: A Hybrid Gaussian Process-Extreme Gradient Boosting Machine Learning Framework for Robust Knockdown Factor Prediction and Reliability-Based Design of Thin Spherical Shell Caps
arxiv.abstract: Elastic buckling remains a critical concern in the design of deep spherical shell caps, given that experiments reveal a significant reduction of critical loads from those predicted by linearized eigen-buckling analysis. This discrepancy has been attributed to initial geometric imperfections and is often reconciled through a dimensionless parameter, namely the knockdown factor (KDF). However, conventional KDFs (NASA SP-8007; Eurocode 3) are highly conservative, as they represent the lower bound of an extensive body of experimental data. This study aims to narrow the conservatism in the KDFs for spherical shell caps through machine learning (ML) regression models trained on experimental data on spherical shell buckling. A hybrid model is proposed by combining Gaussian Process Regression (GPR) with Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), and its improved performance is demonstrated over conventional ML algorithms, i.e., the Artificial Neural Network (ANN), Support Vector Regressor (SVR), Random Forest Regressor (RFR), and Histogram-based Gradient Boosting (HGBoost). Each of these models uses six input features and a single output, i.e., the KDF. The most critical feature affecting the KDF is ascertained through a sensitivity analysis. The study concludes with a reliability-based design framework that relies on the predictive ML model to obtain safety-consistent, yet less conservative, KDFs.
arxiv.titleZh: 用于薄壁球壳盖稳健折减系数预测与基于可靠度设计的混合高斯过程-极端梯度提升机器学习框架
arxiv.summaryZh: 深球壳盖的弹性屈曲实验中，临界载荷远低于线性特征屈曲分析预测值，传统折减系数(NASA SP-8007、Eurocode 3)取大量实验数据的下界，保守度很高。该工作用球壳屈曲实验数据训练回归模型，提出高斯过程回归(GPR)与XGBoost的混合模型，以六个输入特征预测折减系数，性能优于ANN、SVR、随机森林与HGBoost等基线，并通过敏感性分析找出影响折减系数的最关键特征。最后给出基于该预测模型的可靠度设计框架，在保持安全一致性的同时降低保守性，可用于压力容器与航天薄壳结构设计。
arxiv.reason: 结构屈曲领域的ML回归应用，与LLM/后训练方向基本无关

arxiv.title: GuidanceNFT: NFT-Based Reward Fine-Tuning of Guided Diffusion Models
arxiv.abstract: DiffusionNFT (NFT) fine-tunes diffusion models toward task-specific rewards, but optimizing these rewards does not guarantee fidelity to the full prompt. Although classifier-free guidance (CFG) strengthens prompt alignment, NFT is formulated as a CFG-free method, and applying CFG to the fine-tuned velocity field can reduce the optimized reward. This motivates optimizing rewards over the guided output distribution while seeking to retain its prompt alignment. However, applying standard NFT directly to guided samples can cause reward degradation or training collapse. We trace this failure to a mismatch between the reference velocity used in the NFT loss and the score of the guided sample distribution, which biases the improvement direction. We propose GuidanceNFT, which estimates the matching reference velocity through online flow matching on guided samples and uses it to correct both regression terms. With an exact reference, the corrected objective recovers NFT's intended update. In our experiments, the learned correction sustains reward improvement under both explicit and built-in guidance. On SD3.5-M, GuidanceNFT achieves higher optimized rewards than NFT with and without CFG across GenEval, text-rendering, and multi-reward objectives, together with better overall prompt alignment as measured by off-domain evaluation metrics. Experiments on models with built-in guidance, including Model Guidance and ELF, further demonstrate improved ImageNet generation, a better perplexity-entropy tradeoff on OpenWebText, and higher accuracy on GSM8K.
arxiv.titleZh: GuidanceNFT:基于 NFT 的引导式扩散模型奖励微调
arxiv.summaryZh: 扩散模型奖励微调方法 NFT 本身按无 CFG 形式推导，若在微调后的速度场上再加 CFG，优化后的奖励反而会下降，而不用 CFG 又难以保证对完整提示词的忠实度。作者将失效原因定位为 NFT 损失中的参考速度与引导样本分布得分不匹配，导致改进方向出现偏差，并提出 GuidanceNFT，通过对引导样本做在线 flow matching 估计匹配的参考速度，并用其修正损失中的两个回归项，在参考速度精确时该目标可退化为 NFT 原本的更新。在 SD3.5-M 上，该方法在 GenEval、文本渲染和多奖励目标上均取得高于 NFT(含与不含 CFG)的优化奖励，同时离域评估指标显示提示词对齐更好;在 Model Guidance 与 ELF 等内置引导模型上还改善了 ImageNet 生成、OpenWebText 的困惑度-熵权衡与 GSM8K 准确率。
arxiv.reason: 扩散模型奖励微调，属低分方向

arxiv.title: Attention Sinks in VLMs Are Borrowed, Not Seen
arxiv.abstract: We study how to detect and mitigate visual attention sinks in vision-language models (VLMs). Visual attention sinks are image tokens that absorb a large share of attention over the image regardless of the query or task, and they mislead methods that treat attention maps as a record of where the model ``looked.'' Prior work has detected sinks through massive activation dimensions and proposed redistributing their attention, but none have addressed what makes a token become a sink. Comparing six candidate detectors on ten VLMs from four families, we find that only the centered cosine similarity between an image token's key and the key of the language model's text-sink detects visual sinks. Thus, a visual sink is an image token whose key aligns with the text-sink's key. Moving a sink's key component along this direction to the median of the image keys sends its attention back to the text-sink (\textbf{Are Borrowed}) while leaving model answers unchanged~(\textbf{Not Seen}). Building on this, we propose a training-free, entropy-triggered re-look that first cleans the attention map, then crops the most-attended region of the cleaned map and inserts it into the reasoning trace. Cleaning adds negligible computation to the forward pass, and the re-look improves accuracy with a mean gain of $+4.3$ points on fine-detail VQA benchmarks across model families.
arxiv.titleZh: VLM中的注意力汇是借来的，而非看到的
arxiv.summaryZh: 视觉注意力汇是在VLM中无视查询与任务、持续吸收大量图像注意力的图像token，会误导把注意力图当作「模型看了哪里」的方法。在四个家族共十个VLM上对比六种检测器后，只有图像token的key与文本汇key的中心化余弦相似度能识别视觉汇，即视觉汇的key与文本汇对齐；把该key分量移到图像key中位数，注意力便回到文本汇而答案不变。据此提出免训练、熵触发的重看机制：先清洗注意力图，再裁剪其中关注度最高的区域插入推理轨迹，前向开销可忽略，细粒度VQA基准上跨模型平均提升4.3分。
arxiv.reason: 揭示VLM视觉注意力汇机制并给出免训练缓解方法，命中多模态理解侧

arxiv.title: What Do Sparse Autoencoder Feature Discovery Scores Identify? From Activations to Interventions
arxiv.abstract: Sparse autoencoder (SAE) features are typically discovered from how their activations co-vary with behaviour, yet they are often used through interventions such as steering or ablation. We take intervention attribution, the first-order effect of a specified intervention on the model output, as our estimand. For a broad class of response functions, we show that observational feature-discovery evidence generally does not identify this attribution, and derive an exact gradient-based decomposition of the gap between linear-probe predictions and intervention attribution. Across four model-SAE pairs, median probe-to-attribution magnitude ratios range from tens to hundreds, while attributions closely track small-step steering. For single-latent ablations with nonzero effects, gradient predictions match the realized sign in 91-97% of cases, compared with 17-35% for probe-implied changes. Attribution-selected sets also produce larger absolute mean ablation effects on held-out prompts than sets selected by correlation, rank tests or probe coefficients. Together, these results establish intervention attribution as a principled, gradient-estimable target for selecting SAE features for intervention.
arxiv.titleZh: 稀疏自编码器特征发现分数究竟识别了什么?从激活到干预
arxiv.summaryZh: SAE特征通常依据激活与行为的协变关系被发现，但实际使用却靠steering或ablation等干预手段。该工作以干预归因(指定干预对模型输出的一阶效应)为估计目标，证明对一大类响应函数而言，观测式特征发现证据一般无法识别该归因，并给出精确的梯度分解，量化线性探针预测与干预归因之间的差距。在四组模型-SAE对上，探针与归因的中位幅度比达数十至数百倍，而归因能紧密跟随小步steering;对单隐变量消融，梯度预测符号在91–97%的情况下与实际一致，探针隐含变化仅17–35%。据此提出把干预归因作为选择SAE特征的原则性、可梯度估计的目标。
arxiv.reason: SAE可解释性与干预归因方法学，扎实但方向偏窄

arxiv.title: Binding Phoneme Identity to Position in Neural Models and the Human Brain
arxiv.abstract: A fundamental challenge in cognitive science and neural computation is the binding problem. Compositional generalization can be achieved by factorizing representations into roles, the structural slots of a representation (e.g., serial position or syntactic function), and fillers, the contents occupying them (e.g., a phoneme or a word), which can be recombined freely to represent novel combinations. How neural systems implement role--filler binding, however, remains unknown. One of its simplest cases is phoneme sequencing, where phoneme identity (filler) must be bound to position (role) so that /gum/ and /mug/ are represented differently. A proposal from NLP, the `onion hypothesis' (Csordas et al., 2024), holds that the direction of the neural population state encodes token identity, while its magnitude encodes position. It was formulated for random token sequences; we extend it to natural language and test it in neural models and the human brain. We first evaluated it in an encoder-decoder trained to repeat English words, using representational geometry analyses and causal interventions. Magnitude alone proves incomplete: position is encoded by magnitude together with a systematic rotation of the state direction, a scheme we formalize as the `spiral hypothesis'. We then analyzed intracranial recordings from the auditory cortex of 20 participants listening to short sentences. Across superior temporal gyrus electrodes, the change in population response between consecutive phonemes decreases in magnitude as position advances, and its direction is aligned within consonants and within vowels but near orthogonal across the two classes, supporting the magnitude coding shared by both accounts. These results provide a geometric account of how neural systems bind phoneme identity to position, and show how neural-model hypotheses can yield testable predictions about human neural computation.
arxiv.titleZh: 在神经模型与人脑中绑定音素身份与位置
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对认知科学与神经计算中的绑定问题，考察音素身份（填充项）如何与序列位置（角色）结合，使 /gum/ 与 /mug/ 得到不同表征。工作把 NLP 的「洋葱假设」（群体状态方向编码 token 身份、模长编码位置）从随机序列扩展到自然语言，先在复述英文单词的编码器-解码器上用表征几何分析与因果干预验证，发现仅靠模长并不充分，位置由模长叠加状态方向的系统性旋转共同编码，并形式化为「螺旋假设」。随后分析 20 名被试听短句时的听觉皮层颅内记录:颞上回电极上相邻音素间群体响应变化的幅度随位置推进而减小，方向在辅音内部与元音内部对齐、在两类之间近乎正交，支持两个假设共有的模长编码。
arxiv.reason: 音素-位置绑定的认知神经科学，与 LLM 后训练/Agent 方向基本无关

arxiv.title: LLM Value Functions for Credit Assignment in Agentic RL
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for large language model (LLM) agents remains challenging in long-horizon tasks with sparse outcome rewards, where assigning credit to individual actions is difficult. Methods such as GRPO assign the same trajectory-level advantage to all actions, while critic-based methods require learning an additional value function that can be costly and unstable. We introduce LLM Value Function RL (LVRL), which uses the pretrained knowledge and in-context learning ability of an LLM to estimate policy-aware state values without finetuning a separate critic. LVRL conditions the value model on group context and calibrates its predictions using known values at the initial and terminal states, enabling step-level credit assignment from estimated value differences. We further extend this idea to learning from an expert policy through on-policy distillation (OPD), introducing LLM Value Function OPD (LVOPD), which focuses teacher supervision on actions associated with decreases in estimated value. We evaluate our approach across diverse agentic benchmarks: AppWorld, BabyAI, and SWE-bench Verified. Across policy scales (4B to 32B), LVRL consistently and substantially outperforms both GRPO and PPO. On AppWorld and SWE-bench Verified, LVRL yields absolute improvements of up to 13.6 and 8.6 percentage points over GRPO. Notably, on tasks requiring extended exploration like BabyAI, LVRL bridges the gap from total failure to 75.0% success. Furthermore, LVOPD yields consistent improvements over standard distillation baselines on AppWorld. Finally, Monte-Carlo analysis confirms that our frozen critic accurately identifies semantic pitfalls and recoveries, proving that LVRL extracts robust, policy-aware step-level credit from sparse terminal outcomes.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向Agentic RL信用分配的LLM价值函数
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对长时程智能体任务中稀疏结果奖励导致的信用分配难题，提出LVRL：利用预训练LLM的上下文学习能力直接估计策略相关的状态价值，无需微调独立critic，并通过组上下文条件化与初始、终止状态已知价值的校准，以价值差分实现步级信用分配。进一步扩展为LVOPD，把on-policy distillation的教师监督集中在价值下降的动作上。在AppWorld、BabyAI、SWE-bench Verified上，4B至32B各规模均稳定优于GRPO与PPO，AppWorld与SWE-bench Verified最高分别提升13.6与8.6个百分点，BabyAI上从完全失败提升到75.0%成功率。
arxiv.reason: Agentic RL信用分配，兼含on-policy蒸馏，直接命中后训练方向

arxiv.title: KhyontekAI at CheckThat! 2026: Multilingual Dense Retrieval and Cross-Encoder Reranking for Scientific Web Claims
arxiv.abstract: Scientific claims shared through social media platforms frequently reference research findings without explicitly linking to the corresponding scientific publications. Automatically retrieving the correct scientific source for such claims is a challenging multilingual retrieval problem involving semantic matching, paraphrasing, noisy social media text, and cross-domain language variation. In this work, we present a multilingual two-stage retrieval framework for CLEF 2026 CheckThat! Task 1 on Source Retrieval for Scientific Web Claims. Our system combines fine-tuned dense retrieval models with cross-encoder reranking for improving multilingual scientific document retrieval. We evaluate multiple transformer-based dense retrieval architectures including multilingual-E5, BGE, and Contriever under different metadata configurations. We further investigate multilingual joint training, retrieval depth analysis, metadata enrichment, and language balancing strategies for improving retrieval effectiveness. Experimental results demonstrate that metadata enrichment consistently improves retrieval effectiveness, while fine-tuned cross-encoder reranking provides additional gains in retrieval precision. Our final multilingual system achieves MRR@5 scores of 0.6222 for English, 0.5112 for German, and 0.6254 for French, with an overall average MRR@5 score of 0.5862.

arxiv.titleZh: KhyontekAI 在 CheckThat! 2026:面向科学网络论断的多语言稠密检索与交叉编码器重排
arxiv.summaryZh: 社交媒体中的科学论断常引用研究成果却不给出对应文献链接，自动为其找到正确科学来源是一个涉及语义匹配、改写、噪声文本与跨语言差异的多语言检索难题。工作构建两阶段框架:先用微调的多语言稠密检索模型(multilingual-E5、BGE、Contriever)召回候选文献，再用交叉编码器重排，并对比元数据增强、多语言联合训练、检索深度与语言平衡等策略。结果显示元数据增强能稳定提升检索效果，微调重排进一步改善精度，最终系统在英语、德语、法语上的 MRR@5 分别为 0.6222、0.5112、0.6254，平均 0.5862。可服务于科学事实核查与跨语言文献检索场景。
