arxiv.title: Latent Taxonomies: How Property Induction Develops in Language Model Pre-training
arxiv.abstract: When told that robins have sesamoid bones, people are far more prone to extend the property to sparrows than to whales. This behavior, called category-based property induction, is well documented in humans, but whether and how it develops in language models trained only to predict the next token is unclear. To shed light on this, we construct a hierarchical taxonomy of synthetic entities grouped by the properties they share. We then inject facts from this latent taxonomy into the continued pre-training of Pythia and OLMo 2 models from 70M to 7B parameters, and track the development of inductive behaviors. We find that taxonomically aligned induction emerges from next-token prediction alone: a property learned for one entity transfers more strongly within its taxonomic category than across categories. Internally, entities that share a deeper category become more similar in activation space, and clustering recovers the full taxonomic tree from entity representations. Contrary to the usual expectation that scale helps, we find that induction weakens with model size when the data budget is fixed, suggesting that larger models memorize individual facts rather than compress them into shared structure. Induction also strengthens with more pre-training before the taxonomy injection, transfers to novel in-context properties, and can be overridden by a latent taxonomy implied by the prompt. Together, these results show that a model's inductive generalization reflects the latent organization of its training data, with implications for data curation and for predicting how far a learned fact will spread.
arxiv.titleZh: 潜在分类体系：属性归纳如何在语言模型预训练中形成
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究语言模型仅靠下一词预测能否自发形成基于类别的属性归纳：构造由共享属性分组的分层合成实体分类树，将其中事实注入 Pythia 与 OLMo 2（70M 至 7B）的继续预训练并追踪归纳行为。结果显示，属性在同一分类类别内的迁移显著强于跨类别，共享更深层类别的实体在激活空间更相似，聚类可还原完整分类树；在固定数据预算下归纳能力随模型规模增大反而减弱，说明大模型倾向记忆单个事实而非压缩为共享结构。归纳还随注入前预训练量增强、可迁移到上下文中的新属性、并能被 prompt 隐含的潜在分类覆盖，为数据管理与事实扩散范围预测提供依据。
arxiv.reason: 预训练内部机制与数据管理研究，方法系统、跨规模证据扎实

arxiv.title: Local Citation Recommendation Without Graph Signals
arxiv.abstract: Resolving correct citations can be a time-consuming task for research writers. We address local citation recommendation (LCR), where the goal is to retrieve appropriate references for a given sentence. Web tools generally depend on the existing citation graph, which may bias results toward citation count or more recent publications. LCR research using full paper texts has been limited by the lack of publicly available data. We present a new dataset, the Local Citation Recommendation Corpus (LCRC), containing 14,735 scientific statements derived from astrophysics review papers, each with one or more citation targets whose full text is accessible via API. Using this dataset we systematically compare retrieval methods and develop a citation recommendation system that avoids citation graph bias while achieving 8.0% improvement in Recall@25 and 6.9% improvement in NDCG@25 over dense retrieval baselines without model fine-tuning. To support reproducibility, we make our code and dataset publicly available.

arxiv.titleZh: 无图信号的局部引文推荐
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究写作中为句子找到正确引用耗时费力，而现有网络工具依赖引文图，易受引用量或新近性偏置影响;基于全文的局部引文推荐研究则因缺乏公开数据而受限。为此构建了 LCRC 数据集，包含 14,735 条取自天体物理综述论文的科学陈述，每条陈述对应一个或多个引用目标，目标全文可通过 API 获取。在该数据上系统比较检索方法，并提出一种规避引文图偏置的推荐系统，在不微调模型的前提下，相较稠密检索基线在 Recall@25 上提升 8.0%、NDCG@25 上提升 6.9%。代码与数据已公开，适用于学术文献检索与科研辅助写作场景。

arxiv.title: How Shared Representations Become Specialized: Formation, Maintenance, and Latent Susceptibility
arxiv.abstract: When several predictions use the same internal representation, information about some targets can remain easier to recover than information about others. We study how this specialization forms, persists, and changes in minimal artificial learners. With reconstruction errors weighted equally during learning, changing which target is observed precisely selects the favored target and redirects an already specialized learner. Removing current support can reduce a formed bias, whereas state-following update feedback can maintain it. We then compare learners formed through different observation and update conditions but matched on specified reconstruction measurements. Both change under the same brief opposing intervention, yet their responses differ. Resetting Adam largely removes the ten-update difference; exchanging its second moment reverses which route is more susceptible. New interventions show that equalizing the mean second-moment scaling reduces but does not remove the difference: its coordinate-wise pattern also matters. With fresh Adam or calibrated SGD, smaller route differences emerge later, whereas 500 common opposing updates bring the selected allocation endpoints close. A further control produces response differences with identical acquisition and equal mean loss weights but jointly different weight variability and realized sequence. Acquisition-selected formation also extends to a symmetric three-target setting. These interventions distinguish specialization's formation, present support, and time-dependent latent susceptibility.
arxiv.titleZh: 共享表征如何走向特化:形成、维持与潜在易感性
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究多个预测共用同一内部表示时，为何部分目标的信息更易被恢复，以及这种特化如何形成、维持与改变。在极简人工学习器上，通过更换被观测目标、撤除当前支持、施加状态跟随的更新反馈等干预，发现观测选择会精确选中被偏好目标，并重定向已特化的学习器。进一步比较在不同观测与更新条件下、但在重构指标上匹配的学习器:同一短暂反向干预下响应不同，重置 Adam 可基本消除十次更新带来的差异，交换二阶矩则反转更易感的那条路径，说明坐标级的二阶矩模式同样重要。该工作把特化的形成、当下支持与时间依赖的潜在易感性区分开，为多目标共享表征的训练动力学提供了机制线索。
arxiv.reason: 共享表征特化与 Adam 动力学，擦边训练稳定性，分量有限

arxiv.title: Guarded Block Transfers for Polytope Distance: Linear Convergence with Explicit Constants and Gap-Certified Screening for SVM Training
arxiv.abstract: Hard-margin SVM training is the distance problem between two convex hulls, which the Triangle Algorithm (TA) solves with a certified duality gap. We propose \emph{guarded block transfers}: $k$ Mitchell--Demyanov--Malozemov (MDM) transfers per scan are aggregated into one exact line search, guarded by a comparison with the single best transfer at a cost independent of the number of points $n$, and replaced by an away step when the leading transfer is capacity-clipped. On the Minkowski-difference polytope, where the objective is $1$-strongly convex, we prove global linear convergence with explicit constants and no combinatorial swap-step bounds; the per-step contraction is $k$-independent and only the drop-count bound grows with $k$, so aggregation is provably safe while the saving in scans is measured, not proved. Since the TA certificate is the Frank--Wolfe gap divided by the current distance, gap-safe screening applies, and we bound the iteration after which it has removed every zero-weight point off the optimal faces by $O\!\left(\tfrac{k}ρ\log\tfrac{1}τ\right)$ up to logarithmic factors in the geometry, $ρ$ the rate constant and $τ$ the optimal-face margin. On five LIBSVM benchmarks, with fairer baselines than our submission, the solver matches the baselines to four or five digits wherever both converge, ties LIBSVM on sparse-support hard margins and beats our blended pairwise conditional gradients (BPCG). But our full-cache sequential minimal optimisation (SMO) code ties or beats it on kernel $L_2$ margins, LIBLINEAR's dual solver is up to $4.5\times$ faster on the separable $L_2$ margin, and our solver is one to three orders of magnitude slower than LIBLINEAR's Newton solver on dense-support $L_2$ margins and than LIBSVM on a nearly touching kernel hull. Its edge is the certificate, not speed.

arxiv.titleZh: 面向多胞体距离的受保护块传输:显式常数的线性收敛与 SVM 训练的间隙认证筛选
arxiv.summaryZh: 硬间隔 SVM 训练等价于两个凸包之间的距离问题，三角形算法(TA)以可认证的对偶间隙求解。本工作提出受保护块传输:每次扫描把 k 次 MDM 传输聚合为一次精确线搜索，以与点数 n 无关的代价同单次最优传输比较做保护，并在主导传输被容量截断时改用 away step。在 Minkowski 差多胞体上证明带显式常数的全局线性收敛，每步压缩率与 k 无关，聚合被证明安全。五个 LIBSVM 基准上，两法均收敛处吻合到四到五位，稀疏支持硬间隔上与 LIBSVM 持平，但比 LIBLINEAR 的 Newton 求解器慢一到三个数量级，优势在于认证而非速度。

arxiv.title: Benchmarking Deep Learning Models for Anomaly Detection in Real-World Cloud Telemetry
arxiv.abstract: Modern cloud platforms generate high-dimensional, noisy telemetry from thousands of microservices. Unlike classical anomaly detection benchmarks, cloud anomalies are short-lived, irregular, and largely non-periodic, making timely detection challenging. We present an empirical benchmark of deep learning models for anomaly detection using a real-world IBM Cloud Console dataset. We evaluate GRU, Transformer, TimesNet, and Autoformer architectures using the Numenta Anomaly Benchmark (NAB), a timing-aware metric that accounts for early detection and false alarms. TimesNet achieves the highest NAB scores due to strong early-detection sensitivity. Transformer models also detect anomalies early but incur higher false-positive rates. An improved GRU autoencoder, incorporating robust scoring and persistence rules, achieves competitive performance with a more stable false-alarm profile. Overall, the modest performance differences suggest that real cloud anomalies are dominated by short-term deviations rather than persistent periodic structure, emphasizing the importance of timing-aware evaluation and robust post-processing.

arxiv.titleZh: 真实云遥测中异常检测的深度学习模型基准评测
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对云平台微服务产生的高维噪声遥测中异常短暂、不规则、非周期而难以实时发现的问题，在 IBM Cloud Console 真实数据集上对 GRU、Transformer、TimesNet、Autoformer 四类模型做了实证基准评测，并采用兼顾提前检出与误报的 NAB 时序感知指标。TimesNet 因早期检测灵敏度最高取得最佳 NAB 分数，Transformer 也能较早检出异常但误报率偏高，引入鲁棒打分与持续性规则的改进 GRU 自编码器以更稳定的误报表现取得有竞争力的结果。各模型性能差距不大，说明真实云异常以短期偏离为主而非持久周期结构，时序感知评估与鲁棒后处理比模型选型更关键。

arxiv.title: ML-CLAPPS: A Probabilistic Framework for Imbalanced Multilabel Learning under Class Prioritization
arxiv.abstract: Real-world datasets often exhibit severe class imbalance, degrading the performance of deep learning models, particularly on rare classes. While imbalance is well studied in binary and multiclass settings, it is substantially more challenging in multilabel problems due to complex label co-occurrence. In clinical applications such as ECG classification, this challenge is coupled with a second critical challenge: the need to prioritize high-risk conditions, regardless of their prevalence, to mitigate the high cost of false negatives. We introduce the Multilabel Class-Prioritized Probabilistic Sampler (ML-CLAPPS), a learnable sampler that optimizes a distribution over training instances to control the model's exposure to different classes. This approach addresses multilabel imbalance while enabling prioritization of significant conditions via a user-defined importance vector (IV). Empirical evaluation on a real-world multilabel ECG image dataset demonstrates that ML-CLAPPS achieves state-of-the-art performance. We show that it aligns class exposure with the specified IV, and that increasing a class's importance leads to corresponding improvements in its classification performance, enabling explicit prioritization of clinically critical conditions.
arxiv.titleZh: ML-CLAPPS:类别优先级下不平衡多标签学习的概率框架
arxiv.summaryZh: 多标签场景下的类别不平衡因标签共现而格外棘手，ECG 等临床任务还要求无论患病率高低都优先保证高危类别的召回，以降低漏诊代价。ML-CLAPPS 是一个可学习的采样器，通过优化训练实例上的分布来控制模型对各标签类别的曝光量，并借助用户定义的重要性向量(IV)显式指定类别优先级。在真实多标签 ECG 图像数据集上取得当前最优性能，且实验显示类别曝光与其 IV 值一致，提高某类重要性可带来该类分类性能的同步提升。适用于医疗诊断等对特定类别误判代价敏感的工程场景。

arxiv.title: Grounding Deep Learning Framework Testing in Data Flow
arxiv.abstract: Data flow underlies deep learning (DL) framework execution, including automatic differentiation and operator-fusion optimization. Bugs involving data flow can cause incorrect results or unexpected behavior. Existing testing methods represent models primarily by operator topology, omitting runtime tensor values and properties and operator input requirements. They therefore cannot distinguish data flows in models with similar topologies, even when these differences affect framework behavior. We introduce the Tensor Flow Graph (TFG) to capture runtime tensor states and operator input requirements. Its nodes represent operators and their input requirements, while its edges record tensor values and properties. Building on the TFG, we propose FlowMuT, a mutation-based testing method grounded in data flow. Mutations are represented as constrained subgraph replacements, with mutation operators derived from prior work and an analysis of mutable data flow objects. In each round, FlowMuT builds a TFG for the seed model, pairs mutation operators with TFG sites, and filters illegal candidates using data flow constraints. It uses LinUCB to select a candidate based on coverage and impact, executes the mutant, updates selection feedback, and uses each accepted mutant as the next seed. We evaluate FlowMuT on PyTorch and MindSpore using representative models from diverse application scenarios. FlowMuT submitted 55 bug reports for cases missed by all baseline methods; developers confirmed 41 reports and fixed the bugs described in 7 reports. FlowMuT achieves 43.4% higher data flow diversity than the strongest baseline and a legal mutant rate of 96.7%, compared with 86.4% without constraints. These results show that testing from a data flow perspective is practical and effective.
arxiv.titleZh: 将深度学习框架测试锚定于数据流
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有深度学习框架测试多以算子拓扑表示模型，忽略运行时张量取值与算子输入要求，难以区分拓扑相似但数据流不同的模型。为此提出张量流图(TFG):节点为算子及其输入要求，边记录张量取值与属性;并构建变异测试方法 FlowMuT，把变异表示为受约束的子图替换，用数据流约束过滤非法候选，借 LinUCB 按覆盖率与影响挑选变异，迭代生成种子。在 PyTorch 与 MindSpore 上，该方法提交 55 个基线全部漏报的缺陷，开发者确认 41 个、修复 7 个，数据流多样性较最强基线高 43.4%，合法变异体率 96.7%(无约束为 86.4%)，说明数据流视角的框架测试可行且有效。

arxiv.title: Passing Tests, Missing Semantics: Evidence of Interpretive Lock-In in Plan-Based DataFrame Code Generation
arxiv.abstract: Planning and revision are intended to bring generated code closer to the task specification. Yet a mistaken interpretation can persist across the plan, implementation, and tests - a pattern we call interpretive lock-in. We investigate this risk on 30 DataFrame tasks derived from TPC Benchmark DS, comparing Frozen One-Pass, Test-Guided Revision, and PlanAudit-Guided Revision. Test-pass counts rose from 22/30 to 29/30 and 30/30, yet no generated solution matched its stored reference output. Evaluator controls returned the expected outcome in 57/57 cases. Same-engine SQL re-execution reproduced 28/30 references; all 77 test-passing runs on these tasks still failed reference agreement. PlanAudit-Guided Revision improved code scores on 3/30 tasks and test coverage on 11/30, but the median paired change was zero for both measures. Failure analysis revealed tests that omitted requirements, adopted candidate-defined schemas, used nondiscriminating fixtures, or repeated the implementation's incorrect logic. Fresh generation on ten targeted tasks produced 0/30 reference matches and 25/25 false passes among test-passing runs. These findings are diagnostic rather than causal: the pipelines differ in feedback, grounding, call budgets, and editing permissions, and the study uses one model and one primary generation per eligible task. Because pre-adjudication human labels were not retained, inter-rater agreement cannot be reconstructed and the mechanism analyses remain exploratory. Overall, increasingly successful self-generated tests did not establish semantic correctness, even after excluding unreproduced references.

arxiv.titleZh: 测试通过，语义缺失:基于计划的DataFrame代码生成中解释性锁定的证据
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对基于计划的DataFrame代码生成，考察「解释性锁定」:错误的任务理解会在计划、实现与测试间层层固化。在TPC-DS衍生的30个任务上，测试通过数从22/30升至29/30与30/30，却没有一个生成解与参考输出一致;同引擎SQL重执行可复现28/30参考，77个通过测试的运行仍全部不匹配。失败分析显示测试会遗漏需求、采用候选自定义schema、使用无区分性fixture或复制实现的错误逻辑，新任务上25/25的通过均为假通过。说明自生成测试的通过率不足以确立语义正确性。

arxiv.title: An Explainable System for Offensive Content Detection in Nastaliq Urdu: Corpus Curation, Transformer Benchmarking, and Word-Level Attribution
arxiv.abstract: Automated moderation systems are deployed at scale, yet they remain opaque to the users and moderators affected by their decisions, and their coverage is almost entirely confined to English. For Urdu written in the Nastaliq script, no such system exists, and the annotated resources it would be built on are drawn largely from Twitter/X, where character limits constrain how users write. Interpretability has received little attention, leaving it unclear what such models actually learn. This study addresses these gaps in three steps. First, we curate and publicly release a corpus of 7604 Nastaliq Urdu Facebook comments, extending an earlier corpus by correcting text-level inconsistencies and re-examining the original labels. Second, we fine-tune four Urdu-capable transformers under a common grid-search protocol and compare them against twelve feature-classifier baselines on identical data partitions. The best configuration, Multilingual Representations for Indian Languages (MuRIL), reaches 87.05% accuracy and 87.06% macro F1, improving on the strongest baseline by 5.52 percentage points, a margin that exceeds the 95% confidence interval on test accuracy; the two leading transformers differ by less than the test set can resolve, and performance is stable across five optimizers. Third, we compute word-level SHAP attributions adapted to right-to-left rendering. Attribution mass concentrates on high-frequency slurs but extends to syntactically neutral function words and to political vocabulary characteristic of the source pages, indicating that aggregate performance may rest partly on lexical and topical regularities rather than a generalizable representation of offensiveness.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向纳斯塔利克体乌尔都语攻击性内容检测的可解释系统:语料构建、Transformer 基准评测与词级归因
arxiv.summaryZh: 纳斯塔利克体乌尔都语的攻击性内容检测尚无可用系统，已有标注资源多取自受字数限制的 Twitter，且模型决策不透明。工作分三步:整理并公开 7604 条 Facebook 评论语料;在统一网格搜索协议下微调四个乌尔都语 Transformer，并与十二个特征-分类器基线在相同数据划分上对比;实现适配从右到左渲染的词级 SHAP 归因。最佳配置 MuRIL 达 87.05% 准确率与 87.06% macro F1，较最强基线高 5.52 个百分点，但归因质量集中于高频侮辱词并扩散到中性功能词与政治词汇，提示性能部分依赖词汇与话题规律而非可泛化的冒犯性表征。
